description:
Records how well the reader recalled one saved quote or poem passage during review, on a 0 to 5 scale, and reschedules its next review: good recall pushes the next review further out, poor recall brings it back soon. It replaces the item's previous schedule.

Use when the reader has answered a review question from list_quotes_due_for_review and says, or it is clear, how well they remembered it. Grades: 0 no memory at all; 1 wrong, but remembered on seeing it; 2 wrong, but it felt familiar; 3 right with serious difficulty; 4 right after hesitation; 5 perfect.

Each call records one review, so grade an item once per review.

Example: {"quote_id": "<quote id>", "quality": 4}

quality.description: How well the reader recalled it, from 0 (not at all) to 5 (perfectly)

name: record_quote_review

next_due_quote.description: The next quote due for review, or null when none is

schedule.description: The quote's schedule after this review

title: Record a quote review
